lines: It cost $1.33 to make this 60-second Pixar-style short.
Behind it is OpenMontage, an open-source repo with over 63,000 stars.
You describe the video. There's no orchestrator code: your coding agent runs the production, from research and script to the final edit.
Your agent gets 12 pipelines, 100+ tools, and 700+ skill files that teach it the craft.
Every provider choice is scored on seven dimensions: task fit first, then quality, control and reliability.
Before you see anything, it reviews its own render. If the review fails, you never see the video.
You stay in control. Script, scenes and assets all wait for your sign-off on a live storyboard.
It quotes the cost before it spends, and caps the budget at $10 by default.
You can also start from a video you love. It keeps the pacing and the hook, and changes the topic.
No paid API keys? It still makes real videos, with free Piper narration and open footage from NASA.
To start, clone the repo and run make setup. Then tell your agent what to make.
